what: Added a MediaPipe camera-to-gate preview with workspace bounds, keyboard turn requests and timing reports.
why: Connect actual model output to the reviewed gate and make detector delays, hand reentry and source failure testable before hardware integration.
details: R requests a turn; C simulates completion; Q quits. 41 tests pass, including watchdog operation while capture/inference stalls and cleanup on failures. Real MediaPipe inference on the official sample detected two hands and produced HOLD; the final offline check measured 11.75 ms read, 33.01 ms inference and 60.15 ms processing age. OpenCV live-camera access was denied by macOS, so live detection and latency milestones remain open. Read-start timing is an estimate, not verified sensor exposure time. No robot connected or privacy settings changed.
